interactions.name: squeeze_preview
interactions.action: Expose parameter q=0..0.5235987756 rad and return-to-rest. During scene construction only, inspect owner transforms at q=0,0.2617993878,0.5235987756 without running physical endpoint/contact tests; spring attachments follow the same body hierarchy.
interactions.expected: Left grip approaches right; knob stays mounted to moving housing, hooks stay attached, coil visibly deforms. Record any visible gap honestly; do not reduce range for neural seams.

interactions.name: knob_preview
interactions.action: Provide unwrapped angle control or bounded speed with stop; demonstrate representative static poses within a turn and allow two full turns with no joint/actuator angular bounds.
interactions.expected: Only ribbed knob rotates relative to housing; silver collar and scale remain on lever. No measured resistance claim.

interactions.name: spring_preview
interactions.action: Expose bounded elastic-shape parameter up to the declared extension and reset through visible skin binding; leave all dynamics testing disabled.
interactions.expected: Nonrigid relative displacement of preserved coil surface is visible in the browser and labelled parameter preview, with no physical pass assertion.

review_requirements: During export, account for every native face exactly once across frame, lever, adjuster and spring surface while retaining UV/PBR. Briefly inspect the neutral assembled preview: both grips, thin coil/hooks, crown aperture, knob/collar, fasteners and counter must remain visible under their declared owners. This is construction integrity, not physical validation.

Using only static preview transforms at squeeze q=0, pi/12 and pi/6, inspect visible junction continuity and upper/lower spring attachments. Lever housing, left grip and adjuster must move together toward the stationary right handle; collar remains on lever. Upper spring pins follow frame and lower pins follow lever. Use consistent SI/root-offset mapping. Record visible gaps or overlap as construction limitations; do not run endpoint/contact tests, simulate, or reduce travel merely for seams.

Export adjustment_rotation as hinge limited=false with no range or angular actuator bounds. In the parameter preview inspect a representative quarter-turn relative to its housing and retain unwrapped angle values through 4*pi; 4*pi is demonstration coverage only. The knob must rotate visibly around its cylinder axis while collar and scale stay on the lever, including when squeeze is nonzero. Do not perform a physical trajectory test.

Construct the coarse flex and actual native-surface skin binding with supported rest offsets, then inspect rest and a bounded nonrigid parameter-preview configuration. Coil surface must change shape rather than only receive a rigid transform, preserve its coils/aperture and keep both endpoint attachments on their owners; couple extension to attachment separation or keep any independent shape perturbation zero at the pins. Save GLB, editable Blender, MJCF and interactive metadata promptly. Label this parameter preview, defer grip indentation and counter operation explicitly, and publish physics_status=not_tested with physics_attempts=0. Legacy load/unload metadata must remain inactive; create no physical reports or trajectories.
